title: imap Cargo.toml features lack doc comments explaining what each enables
description: Three new features added in bcd64f5 (aws, azure, gcp) enable the corresponding secretx backends for credential_file secretx: URIs. There is no doc comment on these features explaining what they do or when to enable them. A user configuring stoa-imap with credential_file = 'secretx+aws-sm://...' who gets a link error will not know they need features=['aws']. Cargo.toml feature doc comments (## prefix lines above each feature) are the idiomatic way to surface this. The reader crate (which already had secretx) should be checked for the same gap.
